entities.name: Adèle Daminois
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adèle Daminois, real name Angélique Adèle Huvey, was a French woman novelist and playwright. She was Maria Du Fresnay's mother as well as Marie-Caroline Du Fresnay's and Ange Du Fresnay's grandmother.
